static_traits.name: Li Li
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系受到影响，倾向回避有拍照的Social gatherings
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；此前not yet接受心理治疗；not yet经历类似心理问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好；Neutral attitude；起初紧张但配合度较高

basic_info.main_problem: 我相信自己喜欢画do not人而not画自己，因为I am ugly，这导致负面的自我认知和回避自画像；我会回避照镜子或自拍，影响自信和艺术表达。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that negative beliefs about appearance are hindering my artistic growth and self-acceptance, so I seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Beginning in adolescence, due to society's standards of beauty and others' past negative comments about my appearance, I formed and internalized the belief 'I am ugly'. This belief gradually affected my self-image and confidence, so that when I try to draw a self-portrait or see my reflection in the mirror I have strong negative experiences, and I further avoid mirrors, selfies and social occasions involving being photographed, affecting artistic creation and daily self-care.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我看起来很丑，画自己只会突出我的缺点
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避自画像，转而只画他人
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am ugly，画出来会很糟糕

special_situations.event: 看到镜子中的自己或注意到自己的倒影
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If seeing myself makes me feel unbearable negative emotions, it means I really am ugly
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 避免看镜子与自我照面
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我看起来很糟糕，最好not要看

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果被拍照，do not人会注意到我的缺点并觉得我丑
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避含拍照的社交活动，减少与朋友的互动

special_situations.event: 他人称赞我的外貌或作品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的正面反馈not可靠或只是客套，without法改变我‘丑’的事实
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate或忽视正面评价，持续保持负面自我认知
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是安慰我，not是真的

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and accepted (including self-acceptance and self-presentation in art)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因外貌被negate、嘲笑或拒绝，暴露自身缺陷后受到评判
defense_goal: 通过回避自画像、回避照镜子与拍照来降低被negate的风险，维持脆弱的自我价值感

object_relations.self_representation: not配被看见、带有缺陷与羞耻的自己
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者（他人/社会美的标准）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to set small goals related to self-portraits or discuss others' positive feedback on their appearance
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将外界视为会挑剔与negate他的评判者，认为自我呈现必然会引发负面评价（移情：Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、支持性的语气；先Empathy其羞耻与紧张，避免直接反驳；以开放式问题引导其具体化情境与证据；提供小步前进的选择，强调自主与可控；避免强行强调外貌评价。

manifestations: 回避含拍照的Social gatherings，减少与朋友互动
朋友并not了解其负性自我认知与回避行为的程度
受社会美的标准与他人评论的影响，难以Freedom地进行自我呈现（自画像）
艺术表达被外在评价主导
outcomes: 创作Freedom受限，艺术成长受阻
自我接纳困难、体验受限

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 内化社会关于美的标准与他人负面评论为自我评价
将“I am ugly”视为确定事实，难以吸收正向反馈

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not向朋友透露其负性自我认知与回避行为的真实程度
将社交中的not适转为自我回避与自我苛责（如避免拍照、避免照镜子）

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 以“I am ugly”的标签严苛评判自己，难以内化他人称赞
在自我呈现（自画像、自拍）上过度谨慎与回避

positive_force: 在为他人作画时感到自信与投入，具备艺术表达的能力
主动寻求咨询，愿意尝试“小步前进”的自画像练习
拥有几位可交谈的亲密朋友（潜在支持资源）
negative_force: 内化社会美标准与他人负评为自我标签（I am ugly）
negate正向反馈，难以吸收赞美与例外证据
持续回避镜子、自拍与含拍照的社交情境，Reinforcement负性自我图式
情绪化推理与读心术等not良认知模式加剧Self-denial

antecedent: 想到要进行自画像练习
target_behavior.core_reason: 青少年时期内化社会美标准与他人负面评论，形成“I am ugly”的核心信念，并以情绪化推理将负性感受当作事实。
target_behavior.function: 逃避被看见的缺陷与潜在羞耻，降低Anxiety与Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: 艺术表达与创作发展受限，作品中的自我呈现匮乏

target_behavior.behavior: 回避照镜子与拍照（含自拍与含拍照的社交活动）
antecedent: 看见镜子或自己的倒影
进入可能拍照的社交场合
被他人邀请合影或自拍
target_behavior.core_reason: 将外貌负评内化为稳定标签，预测他人负面评价并以情绪化推理加深羞耻与Anxiety。
target_behavior.function: 逃避外界评价与负性情绪体验，维持脆弱的自我价值感
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased self-confidence、社交关系受影响、日常自我照料习惯受损
